		scan.nextLine();
		scan.nextLine();
		char[] chars = input.toCharArray();

		brackets = 0;
		for(int i = 0; i < chars.length && i < max; i++){
			char c = chars[i];

			if((c == '(' || c == '_') && (chars[i + 1] == '(' || chars[i + 1] == '_') )
				continue;
			brackets += (c == '(') ? 1 : 0;
			if(c != '_' && i > 0 && !Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)){
				char prev = chars[i - 1];
				if(prev == '(' || prev == '_')
					continue;
				else{
					max = Math.max(max,
							chars[i - 1] == '_'? getWordLength(chars,
									i - 2) : getWordLength(chars, i - 1));
					}
				}

		}
		System.out.println(max + " " + (brackets + (chars[0] == '(' ? (chars.length - 1) :
				chars.length)));
	}

	public static int getWordLength(char[] chars, int i){
		int num = 0;
		while(i >= 0){
			char c = chars[i];
			if(Character.isLetterOrDigit(c))
				num++;
			else
				break;
			i--;
		}
		return num;
	}
}
